<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="configuration">
<h1>Configuration</h1>
<p>Configuration lives in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.toml</span></code>.</p>
<section id="important-sections">
<h2>Important sections</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[source]</span></code> controls the canonical source dialect and extensions.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[ids]</span></code> controls ledger ID prefix/width and optional ID segment behavior.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[build]</span></code> controls default output behavior and converter selection.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[tracking]</span></code> controls workspace snapshots and change detection.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[arc42]</span></code> controls document metadata defaults.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[skill]</span></code> points agents at the repository skill file.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="example">
<h2>Example</h2>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">config_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">7</span>
<span class="n">archledger_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.archledger&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[ids]</span>
<span class="n">prefix</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;al&quot;</span>
<span class="n">width</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span>
<span class="n">segment_mode</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;none&quot;</span>
<span class="n">default_segment</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;content&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[ids.segment_map]</span>
<span class="n">section</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;content&quot;</span>
<span class="n">requirement</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;content&quot;</span>
<span class="n">risk</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;risk&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[source]</span>
<span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;markdown&quot;</span>
<span class="n">section_extension</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">record_extension</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">schema_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">2</span>

<span class="k">[build]</span>
<span class="n">default_output</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;architecture.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">default_format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;markdown&quot;</span>
<span class="n">default_output_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;build&quot;</span>
<span class="n">converter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;auto&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[tracking]</span>
<span class="n">enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">state_file</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;source-state.json&quot;</span>
<span class="n">scanner</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;auto&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[build].default_output_dir</span></code> is relative to the directory containing
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.toml</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.archledger.toml</span></code>.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source-state.json</span></code> stores SHA-256 content hashes only for files. It does not
persist mtimes or file sizes. Directory hashes are derived from file hashes.</p>
<p>The archive path is fixed at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;archledger_dir&gt;/archive</span></code> and is used by
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">archive</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span> <span class="pre">--repair</span></code> to preserve
ledger-number history without renumbering.</p>
</section>
<section id="id-segment-modes">
<h2>ID segment modes</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment_mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;none&quot;</span></code>
IDs use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;prefix&gt;_&lt;number&gt;</span></code> (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_0013</span></code>).</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment_mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;type&quot;</span></code>
IDs use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;prefix&gt;_&lt;segment&gt;_&lt;number&gt;</span></code> (for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">al_risk_0014</span></code>).</p>
<p>Segment resolution order is deterministic:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">id_segment</span></code> metadata on the record</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[ids.segment_map]</span></code> by record <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">type</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">default_segment</span></code></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The numeric ledger sequence remains global across all segments.</p>
</section>
<section id="per-output-overrides">
<h2>Per-output overrides</h2>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[build.outputs.&lt;format&gt;]</span></code> for format-specific settings. Supported keys are
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tool</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pdf_engine</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reference_docx</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">enabled</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
